Class GameController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.controller.GameController
public class GameController extends Object
Application controller for the game. Public actions catch IllegalMoveException thrown by the model and translate the outcome into false; the model already broadcasts the corresponding event.

Note: orderTileOrder is the only variable that always knows all players.

    • start

      public void start()
      Starts the game state machine by executing the initial SetupPhase. Must be called only after all GameStateObservers have been registered, so that SETUP_COMPLETED and START_TURN_COMPLETED events reach every view.

      Returns:

    • declareExceptionalWin

      public void declareExceptionalWin(Player winner)
      Declares an immediate, technical victory for the given player (e.g. all other players abandoned the game, or the Cugola easter egg). Raises GameEvent.Type.EXCEPTIONAL_WIN; no score recomputation is performed. Must run on the game's command queue.
      Parameters:
      winner - the winning player
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if winner is null

    • reconnectPlayer

      public boolean reconnectPlayer(Player player, VirtualView view)
      Reintegrates a disconnected player and re-registers their view as observer. Must run on the game's own command queue.
      Parameters:
      player - the returning player
      view - the player's new virtual view
      Returns:
      true if the player was reintegrated
